The first significant figure is the first ?

NON-ZERO digit

0️⃣ Front zeros

In 0.0046 the zeros at the front are ?

NOT significant

round UP

370 to 1 s.f. is 400, not ?

4 (keep the place value)

📺 2.8M subscribers

Thumbnails never show the exact number. Why?

A YouTuber has 2 847 105 subscribers. The thumbnail says 2.8M. How many significant figures?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

2.8M = 2 800 000

digits kept: 2 and 8

Step 2

Count them

2 significant figures

2 s.f. Nobody counts the last 47 105 fans 📺

Q1

Calculator

[5 marks]

The walls of a hall have an area of 286.4 m². 1 litre of paint covers 11.8 m². Paint comes in 2.5 litre tins costing £18.75. First estimate the litres needed. Then work out the exact cost of the tins.

Hint

Answer

Round to 1 s.f. to estimate. Then litres, then tins (round up).

Answer: £187.50

click to solve →

Q2

Calculator

[5 marks]

A lottery jackpot of £3 846 275 is shared equally by 7 winners. Work out each share to the nearest penny. Write it to 2 significant figures and to 1 significant figure. A news report says each winner gets "about half a million pounds". Is the report right?

Hint

Answer

Divide first. Then the deciding digit each time.

Answer: £549 467.86; yes

click to solve →

Q3

Calculator

[6 marks]

147 students go on a trip. Coaches have 49 seats and cost £1180 each. Entry is £12.80 per student. The teacher estimated the total cost as £5000. Work out the exact total. How much more or less is it than the estimate?

Hint

Answer

Coaches, entry, then add.

Answer: £5421.60: £421.60 more
